description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Mohamed Ismail Mohamed Thasleem as Chairman of the Eravur Urban Council and Mr. Mohamed Rizwan Sabar as a member of the Puttalam Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government councils (Eravur Urban Council and Puttalam Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including declarations of elected officials to fill positions that became vacant due to resignation or election to another office. This falls squarely under Election-related matters.
